title: Exotic Surfaces in 4-manifolds and Surface Corks
summary: A fundamental result in 4-manifold topology asserts that any two exotic smooth structures on a simply-connected, closed 4-manifold differ by a cork twist: the operation of removing a compact, contractible, codimension-zero submanifold and regluing it by a diffeomorphism of its boundary. In this paper, we introduce the notion of a surface cork, an analogous object in the setting of smoothly embedded, closed surfaces $F$ in closed 4-manifolds $X$.
